description: A cable panel in the round: two knit stitches, then a purl, a 2/2 right cross and a purl worked 4 times (26 stitches). The cable sits wholly inside the motif and is worked once per repeat. Round 3 marks a repeat whose edge cuts through the cable, which Ply refuses.

rows.written: Round 2: k2, *p, k4, p; rep from * to end
Round 3: (repeats need fixing: the repeat over cols 1-5 splits the cable at cols 4-7; a cable must be wholly inside or outside a repeat)

issues.message: row 3: the repeat over cols 1-5 splits the cable at cols 4-7; a cable must be wholly inside or outside a repeat
